title: Making Friends
summary: 国际社交、兴趣交流、现在完成时入门。
objectives: Start conversations and ask follow-up questions
Discuss experiences and specific past events

lessons.title: Start a Conversation
lessons.subtitle: 用共同场景开启对话
grammar: Is this your first time ...?；开放式问句

vocabulary.example: I’m here for the language exchange.

listening.title: Start a Conversation
listening.transcript: Is this your first time at the exchange? Mine too. I’m here to practise Spanish. How did you hear about the group?

questions.q: What language does the speaker want to practise?

speaking.prompt: 用两种不同的开场白和一位新朋友说话，再问一句开放式问题。
speaking.sample: Hi, is this your first time here? What brought you to the exchange?

reading.title: 用共同场景开启对话
reading.text: New members meet by the door at 6:45. Pick up a name tag and join a group at seven. Tell your group which language you want to practise.

questions.q: When do new members meet by the door?

writing.prompt: 写 55–70 词欢迎新人，给出见面安排和一个可以回答的话题。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（Is this your first time ...?；开放式问句）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: What 提问常能引出更多信息。
quiz.prompt: Which question invites a longer answer?
What does “exchange” mean in this lesson?

listening.title: Keep the Conversation Going
listening.transcript: I enjoy making games with friends. Really? What kind of games do you make? Mostly small puzzle games. We meet online once a week.

questions.q: What kind of games do they make?

speaking.prompt: 听到对方说喜欢做游戏或旅行后，给一句回应，再追问两个细节。
speaking.sample: That sounds fun. What kind of games do you make? How often do you meet?

reading.title: 回应对方并接着追问
reading.text: Lina says she enjoys hiking. Omar asks where she usually goes. When she mentions a local park, he asks which trail she recommends for beginners.

questions.q: What does Omar ask for at the end?

writing.prompt: 写一段 8 行聊天，至少有两次根据上句内容进行追问。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（Really?；What do you like about ...?）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: 追问应延续对方刚提到的话题。
quiz.prompt: Which is a useful follow-up to “I enjoy hiking”?
What does “follow-up” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: Have You Ever Been There?
lessons.subtitle: 问对方有没有某种经历
grammar: Have you ever + 过去分词?

vocabulary.example: I’m here for the language exchange.

listening.title: Have You Ever Been There?
listening.transcript: Have you ever been to Malaysia? Yes, I have. I went to Penang last year. I loved the night markets there.

questions.q: Where did the speaker go last year?

speaking.prompt: 用 Have you ever 提三个旅行问题，再就一个回答用过去时追问。
speaking.sample: Have you ever travelled alone? Where did you go?

reading.title: 问对方有没有某种经历
reading.text: At the travel club, everyone asks a partner about past experiences. You can ask whether they have ever travelled alone or stayed with a host family.

writing.prompt: 写一段对话，包含两个 Have you ever 问题和一个有具体时间的回答。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（Have you ever + 过去分词?）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Have you ever 后用过去分词 been。
abroad 在本课中指在国外。
quiz.prompt: What does “abroad” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: I’ve Never Tried It
lessons.subtitle: 说明有过或没有过的体验
grammar: have/has never + 过去分词；一般过去时补具体细节

listening.title: I’ve Never Tried It
listening.transcript: I’ve never tried skiing, but I’ve been ice skating. I went skating with my sister last winter. We want to go again this year.

questions.q: What has the speaker never tried?

speaking.prompt: 说两种你没尝试过的活动，以及一种尝试过的活动和具体时间。
speaking.sample: I’ve never tried skiing. I’ve been ice skating. I went last winter.

reading.title: 说明有过或没有过的体验
reading.text: Aki has never joined a cooking class. His friend Jo has taken one before. She took a bread-making class in March and recommends it to beginners.

questions.q: What did Jo learn to make?

writing.prompt: 写 65–80 词给活动搭子，交流做过、没做过以及想一起尝试的事。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（have/has never + 过去分词；一般过去时补具体细节）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Has never 后用过去分词 taken。
quiz.prompt: She has never ___ a cooking class.
What does “try” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: Would You Like to Join Us?
lessons.subtitle: 邀请、接受和礼貌婉拒
grammar: Would you like to + 动词原形?

vocabulary.example: Would you like to join us?

listening.title: Would You Like to Join Us?
listening.transcript: Would you like to join us for lunch on Saturday? I’d love to, but I’m working at noon. Are you free for coffee after three instead?

questions.q: What does the second speaker suggest?

speaking.prompt: 邀请新朋友参加活动，然后练习接受和婉拒两种回答。
speaking.sample: Would you like to join us? I’d love to, but I’m working. How about Sunday instead?

reading.title: 邀请、接受和礼貌婉拒
reading.text: We’re meeting for board games on Thursday at seven. New players are welcome. Please reply by Wednesday so we can book enough seats.

writing.prompt: 写一条 60–75 词的邀请，给出活动、日期、地点和回复截止时间。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（Would you like to + 动词原形?）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Would you like to 后用动词原形。
quiz.prompt: Would you like ___ us for lunch?
What does “join” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: What Did You Mean?
lessons.subtitle: 请求重说或确认意思
grammar: Could you say that again?；Do you mean ...?

vocabulary.example: Would you like to join us?

listening.title: What Did You Mean?
listening.transcript: Let’s meet by the main hall at quarter to seven. Could you repeat the time? Of course, six forty-five, just outside the main hall.

questions.q: What time do they agree on?

speaking.prompt: 请对方重复一个时刻，用自己的话确认位置，再询问一个陌生表达。
speaking.sample: Could you say that again? Do you mean six forty-five outside the main hall?

reading.title: 请求重说或确认意思
reading.text: The notice says to bring something to share. A member asks what that means. The organiser says food is welcome, but a story or a photo is also fine.

questions.q: What else can members bring besides food?

writing.prompt: 写 60–75 词确认一个你没听清的活动安排。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（Could you say that again?；Do you mean ...?）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Do you mean ...? 用来核对理解。
options: Do you mean outside the hall?
quiz.answer: Do you mean outside the hall?

quiz.prompt: What does “clarify” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: Weekly Challenge: Make a New Friend
lessons.subtitle: 完成开场、追问、邀约与确认
grammar: 综合一般过去时、现在完成时和礼貌追问

vocabulary.example: Would you like to join us?

listening.title: Weekly Challenge: Make a New Friend
listening.transcript: I’m new to the city and I like photography. I’ve never been to the riverside market. Some friends are going there on Sunday, and you’re welcome to come.

questions.q: Where are the friends going on Sunday?

speaking.prompt: 模拟两分钟聊天，先聊摄影，再问一次经历并确认集合时间。
speaking.sample: I enjoy taking photos too. Have you ever joined a photo walk? Do you mean eleven outside the market?

reading.title: 完成开场、追问、邀约与确认
reading.text: Photo walk: meet outside the market at eleven. Bring a camera or phone. The walk is free, but space is limited to twelve people. Send Jo a message to join.

writing.prompt: 写 85–105 词跟进这次见面，提到共同兴趣、问一个问题并确认活动。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（综合一般过去时、现在完成时和礼貌追问）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Have you ever 提问不限某个具体的过去时刻。
options: Have you ever joined a photo walk?
Did you join one last Sunday?
quiz.answer: Have you ever joined a photo walk?
quiz.prompt: Which question asks about experience without naming a time?

quiz.explanation: keep in touch 在本课中指保持联系。
quiz.prompt: What does “keep in touch” mean in this lesson?
